mapper.sql: settings.setting_id as "settingId", settings.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", versions.version_code as "versionCode", versions.version_status as "versionStatus", settings.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", settings.area_code as "areaCode", settings.element_code as "elementCode", settings.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", settings.management_item_name as "managementItemName", settings.teacher_editable_part as "teacherEditablePart", settings.sort_order as "sortOrder", settings.active_yn as "activeYn", settings.change_reason as "changeReason", settings.updated_by as "updatedBy", settings.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from evaluation_element_management_item_settings settings inner join evaluation_rule_versions versions on versions.rule_version_id = settings.rule_version_id
mapper.select: select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{ruleVersionId}

insert into evaluation_element_management_item_settings ( rule_version_id, evaluation_year, area_code, element_code, management_item_code, management_item_name, teacher_editable_part, sort_order, active_yn, change_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by ) values ( #{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.areaCode}, #{request.elementCode}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.managementItemName}, #{request.teacherEditablePart}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{requestId}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} ) on conflict (rule_version_id, evaluation_year, area_code, element_code, management_item_code) do update set management_item_name = EXCLUDED.management_item_name, teacher_editable_part = EXCLUDED.teacher_editable_part, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by returning setting_id as "settingId", rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", (select version_code from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = evaluation_element_management_item_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionCode", (select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = evaluation_element_management_item_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionStatus", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", area_code as "areaCode", element_code as "elementCode", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", management_item_name as "managementItemName", teacher_editable_part as "teacherEditablePart", sort_order as "sortOrder", active_yn as "activeYn", change_reason as "changeReason", updated_by as "updatedBy", updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.insert: insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
